question: What should I bring to a public swim?
answer: You should bring swimwear, a towel, and a €0.50 coin for the lockers.

question: Do I need a €1 coin for the lockers?
answer: No, lockers require a €0.50 coin

question: Can I pay with a credit card?
answer: Yes, we accept all major credit cards through our secure BOIPA payment system.

question: Are walk-ins allowed?
answer: Yes, walk-ins are allowed, but we recommend booking in advance to secure your spot.

question: Can I use a coupon for school lessons?
answer: Yes, credit notes and coupons can be applied to school lessons during checkout.

question: Can I use a credit note or coupon for public lessons?
answer: Yes, coupons issued for missed sessions can be used when booking public lessons.

question: Do I need to create an account to book a session?
answer:
Yes, you'll need to create a quick account to book swims or lessons and manage your bookings.

Register Here

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Yes. All payments are processed through BOIPA, a secure payment gateway that protects your card details.

question: What happens if I miss a lesson?
answer: If a lesson is missed, we may issue a coupon (credit note) depending on the circumstances. Please contact us.

question: How long is each swim session?
answer: Swim sessions typically last between 45 and 60 minutes. The exact time is shown in the session list.

question: What ages are allowed for public swims?
answer: Public swims are open to all ages. Children under 8 must be accompanied in the water by an adult.

question: How do I know what level to book for my child?
answer:
Our instructors assess each swimmer and recommend the appropriate level. If unsure, ask the staff at reception.

If your child is in our classes, their level information can be found on your swimling dashboard.

question: Can my child repeat a level?
answer: Yes, it’s normal and beneficial for a child to repeat a level to master the core aquatic skills confidently.

question: Are family swims available?
answer: Yes, family swim sessions are listed under “Public Swims.” Prices vary by group size.

question: Can I cancel or reschedule a booking?
answer: Cancellations are possible depending on timing and policy. Please log into your account or contact us directly.

question: Is there a waiting list I can join for Public lessons?
answer: Yes! When you see a lesson is full, you will be given the option to join a waiting list. This list is actively monitored and you will be informed by email when a place becomes available.

question: Do I need to wear a swimming hat?
answer: Yes, swimming hats are required for all swimmers in the pool. They help keep the water clean and ensure better hygiene for everyone.

question: Can I buy swimming hats or goggles at the pool?
answer: Yes, swimming hats and goggles are available for purchase at reception. Just ask a staff member when you arrive.

question: Are there discounts for children, OAPs, or students?
answer: Yes! We offer discounted rates for children, students, and OAPs. Infants under 3 years old can swim for free. Please check the pricing listed with each session or ask at reception for details.

question: What age is considered an infant?
answer: For our swim sessions, an infant is any child under the age of 3. Infants under 3 years swim free of charge when accompanied by a responsible adult.

question: Is there a waiting list for lessons?
answer: Yes there is a waiting list and you can sign up at any time. Just register as a user(all that is required is an email), then under the menu you will see a  Waiting List Registration. Fill out the form there and you will be processed in order. It is a good idea to be as specific as possible i.e. what is your preferred lesson, and in the notes specify flexibility or restrictions. e.g. Thursdays, Fridays but not Saturday.

question: How do I book a lesson?
answer:
Before you can book into lessons you must register  Sign Up  . Make sure you tick the box "I wish to sign up for swimming lessons." After you are signed in you should see a menu Swimling Dashboard there you can add swimmers and book them into lessons.
You can Register Here

question: How do I book a public swim?
answer:
In order to book a public swim you must register ( all you need is an email address). Once loggeid in  you will be able to book a swim from the menu.

You can Register Here

question: What do I need to bring to a swim?
answer: Hat, goggles, swimsuit, flipflops and armbands (if needed)

question: What age do lessons begin from?
answer: We only accommodate for children over the age of four.

question: Do I need to book into the public swimming sessions?
answer: It is recommended that you book before your swim in order to assure a place, however, if space allows you can come down and pay at the desk.

question: What is aqua aerobics?
answer:
Aqua aerobics is a form of exercise performed in shallow water that combines aerobic movements with the resistance of water to improve fitness, strength, and flexibility. The Aqua aerobics class is very popular so it is advisiided to book in advance. To book you need to be registered (all you need is an email address).

You can Register Here

question: How long is a term ?
answer: A term runs for 3 months.

question: Do you sell swimming equipment?
answer: At the desk we sell hats (rubber and cloth), goggles (both kids & adults), armbands, nose plugs, ear plugs, we DO NOT sell towels, swimsuits, shampoo, etc.

question: Can I bring my baby to the pool?
answer: Yes, you can bring your baby to the pool, but they may need to wear a swim nappy if not toilet trained. Always follow the facility’s age, safety, and supervision guidelines. You must always hold them or have an appropriate floatation device.

question: What is a Public Swim?
answer:
Public Swim - Open swim session suitable for family’s and leisure swimmers, those practicing swimming up to being able to swim lengths continuously (no lanes) 

Adult €6 / Child €4 / Under 3 Free / OAP €3:50

question: What are Lane Swims?
answer:
25m lengths roped off, suitable for proficient swimmers who are moving continuously up and down the pool.  Lanes are categorised as Fast - lane 3 / Medium lanes 2 & 4 / Slow lanes 1 & 5 

Adult €6 / OAP €3:50

question: What are Coached Ladies Lanes?
answer: These session are suitable for ladies progressing from Advanced lessons, or beginner - advanced lane swimmers improving technique with a coach €7:25

question: What are Ladies Lessons / Ladies Coached Widths class?
answer: These sessions are suitable for Ladies learning and improving on technique from Beginner to Advanced levels €7:25

question: What are Coached Lanes?
answer:
Coached Lanes are suitable for all those ages 13+ - lane swim for those progressing from children’s lengths classes/teens continuing to swim, progression from adult lessons, beginner triathletes 

Adult €7:25 / Teen €5

question: What are Masters sessions?
answer: The next stepup from CoachedLanes.suits 18+, competent swimmers capable of a structured training session, those progressing from coached sessions, ex-competitive swimmers, triathletes, open water swimmers, or those training for an event €7:25

question: Do you do Water safety training?
answer:
Water safety classes are run by a Water Safey Ireland instructors. They usually take place on a Sat evening from 7-8:30pm and are  for competent swimmers aged 13 and over. 

Templeogue College Swim Pool does not run this activity - for more information please contact Sean Fleming @ seanfleming388@gmail.com

question: Are there changing facilities?
answer:
We have 4 changing rooms:  

1. MALE only Changing room. BOYS ONLY in this room (There should NOT be any females in this side) 

2. FEMALE only Changing room. GIRLS ONLY in this room (There should NOT be any males in this side) 

3. FAMILY Changing Room (Male Side). Parents typically changing children Under 8 (as required to assist)  - MOST of these children will be accompanied by a Male parent/guardian. Female parents are NOT ALLOWED in the male shower area.

4. FAMILY Changing Room (Female Side). Parents typically changing children Under 8 (as required to assist) - MOST of these children will be accompanied by a Female parent/guardian. Male parents are NOT ALLOWED in the Female shower area.

The privacy and safety of ALL customers should be respected by ALL.

question: Are there showers available?
answer:
Yes!. 

Showers are exclusively gender specific -  FEMALE PARENTS should NEVER be present in the Male Showers -  MALE PARENTS should NEVER be present in the Female Showers 

The privacy and safety of ALL customers should be respected by ALL

question: Can I borrow a swim hat?
answer: Yes at receiption

question: When will my child be ready for the next level?
answer: Your child's usual teacher is the best person to answer this question. We recommend catching their attention five minutes before or after your child's lesson to have a quick conversation about your child's progress.

question: Do you offer lessons for adults who are just learning to swim?
answer:
Yes, we offer lessons for adults of all levels.

We offer adults Beginner lessons on Wednesday nights from 8:10 pm to 8:55 pm. For intermediate adults, we recommend our Adults & Teens sessions (Monday and Friday evenings). For more competitive or experienced swimmers, we recommend our Masters sessions (Monday and Wednesday nights). Please see the pool timetable for all these times.

question: Does my child need armbands?
answer: We would recommend armbands for new or inexperienced swimmers starting in lessons (until they are swimming with their face in the water).

question: Do you have any open swims for adults?
answer: Public swims are available to all swimmers. Lane swims are available for competent adult swimmers.

question: Do you have any lane swims for adults?
answer: Adult lane swims run early morning on weekdays and some lunchtimes. As times vary and can change, please see our timetable for up-to-date sessions.

question: Do you have family changing rooms?
answer:
We have 4 changing rooms:  

1. MALE only Changing room. BOYS ONLY in this room (There should NOT be any females in this side) 

2. FEMALE only Changing room. GIRLS ONLY in this room (There should NOT be any males in this side) 

3. FAMILY Changing Room (Male Side). Parents typically changing children Under 8 (as required to assist)  - MOST of these children will be accompanied by a Male parent/guardian. Female parents are NOT ALLOWED in the male shower area.

4. FAMILY Changing Room (Female Side). Parents typically changing children Under 8 (as required to assist) - MOST of these children will be accompanied by a Female parent/guardian. Male parents are NOT ALLOWED in the Female shower area.

The privacy and safety of ALL customers should be respected by ALL.

question: Can I use the pool equipment?
answer: Pool equipment is only for use during classes. If you require something for use or a flotation device, please ask the lifeguard.

question: Can I bring my own equipment to public and family swims?
answer:
We allow some small equipment, toys and flotation devices in public sessions.

We do not allow the use of rings, baby seats, fins or large inflatables during public sessions.

question: Can I bring my own toys to public and family swims?
answer:
We allow some small equipment, toys and flotation devices during public sessions.

We do not allow the use of rings, baby seats, fins or large inflatables during public sessions.

question: Can I bring my own flippers/fins to public and family swims?
answer: We do not allow the use of flippers or fins during public sessions.

question: Do I have to wear flip-flops?
answer: You are not required to wear flip-flops, although we would recommend it.

question: Can I wear swim shoes or socks?
answer:
We do not recommend the use of Swim shoes/socks

Aqua shoes/shocks can be worn during aqua aerobics classes.

Swim Shoes are not allowed during swimming lessons. Swim socks are only recommended if required for a current foot complaint. Flip-flops or Crocs are sufficient for foot hygiene when travelling to and from the pool area.

question: Can my child wear swim shoes or socks?
answer: Swim Shoes are not allowed during swimming lessons; swim socks are only recommended if required for a current foot complaint. Flip-flops/Crocs are sufficient for foot hygiene when travelling to and from the pool area.

question: What can I wear in the pool?
answer: Appropriate swimwear should be worn in the pool. Swim shorts, trunks or a swimsuit or togs. General streetwear clothing made of cotton material etc, is not permitted for safety reasons.

question: Can I wear a T-shirt in the pool?
answer: Normal T-shirts are not permitted in the pool. If required, a swim top can be worn if made of swim-appropriate material and should not be oversized.

question: How many levels for children are there?
answer: We run 5 children’s widths levels and 3 lengths levels.

question: How do move-ups work?
answer: Swimmers are assessed on an ongoing basis by their teacher and moved accordingly depending on space. Most progressions will occur at the end of a term. If a child is ready to progress, we will look after all of the admin for you!

question: How do I move my child to the next level?
answer: Progression of levels is decided by the class teacher. We will notify you when your child is ready to move. If you require information on your child’s progression, please speak to their class teacher.

question: My child was injured/sick, can I get a refund for the lessons missed?
answer: Medical credit is assessed and allocated on a case-by-case basis. Medical credit can be issued for long-term absence only with a doctor’s letter.

question: My child missed lessons because of a holiday. Can I get a refund?
answer:
We do not offer refunds for missed classes due to holidays.

For the Summer term (July - September) there is a coupon which can be used if you miss 2 weeks for a holiday.

question: Will there be a lifeguard on duty?
answer: All public sessions will have a lifeguard on duty.

question: Are there age restrictions for public swims?
answer: Our public swim sessions welcome swimmers of all ages. We have family-friendly sessions, as well as some specialised sessions for ladies only. Children under 8 must be accompanied by a responsible adult at all times.

question: Do teachers teach scripted lessons?
answer: No, our teachers do not teach scripted lessons

question: How deep is the pool?
answer: One end of the pool is 3', while the other is 3' 3". The centre of the pool is 6' 6". The depth is marked on the wall of the pool so you can always be sure you're within your depth.

question: Do you have aqua aerobics classes?
answer: Yes, we have an aqua aerobics class on a Tuesday evening @ 20:35.

question: How does one enter the pool?
answer: Our pool is entered via a ladder at both shallow ends.

question: Do you offer private/1-2-1 lessons?
answer: We currently do not offer private/1-2-1 lessons.

question: When will the next term of lessons start?
answer: Our lessons run year-round. Terms start in January, April, July, and October.

question: Do you open on Bank Holidays?
answer: No, we do not open on Bank Holiday Mondays.

question: Can I take pictures in the pool?
answer: No, photography/recording of any kind on any device is not permitted in the building.

question: What facilities are available?
answer: We have a 5-lane 25m heated pool (30°C) with two shallow ends (3' and 3'3") and a deeper middle section(6'6"). Changing rooms, lockers, and poolside seating are available. Some sessions include designated lanes for length swimming. We are a pool-only facility, meaning we do not have a sauna, steam room, etc.

question: At what age can my child start lessons?
answer: We offer lessons to children four years old and above
